title: Black voters, divided on progressives, are pivotal in Michigan Senate primary
description: A disruptor or a pragmatist? In Tuesday's contest between Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens, Democrats weigh whether to remake the political system or work within it.

title: For Republicans planning post-Trump future, one race in Washington is worth watching
description: The primary to replace Rep. Dan Newhouse is a rare opportunity for Washington's Republicans to seek federal office. Candidates representing different wings of the party are testing Trump's influence.

title: Activist David Hogg talks about the future of the Democratic Party
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with gun violence prevention activist David Hogg about the future of the Democratic Party and calls for him to lead the Democratic National Committee.

title: Trump and Senate GOP deadlocked on key issues as congressional recess approaches
description: With a long congressional recess set to begin at the end of the week, Senate Republicans have a lot they want to accomplish. But they're deadlocked with President Trump on several key GOP priorities.

title: Political strategist weighs in on the tension between Trump and Senate Republicans
description: NPR's A Martinez speaks with political strategist Alex Conant about the tensions between the Senate and President Trump ahead of the long congressional recess that starts later this week.

title: Kay Granger, first GOP woman from Texas to win House seat, dies at 83
description: The trailblazing Republican served as the first female mayor of Fort Worth and spent 28 years in Congress, rising to lead the Appropriations Committee.

title: Todd Blanche rescinds Trump's 'anti-weaponization fund' ahead of nomination hearing
description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche issued a formal order late Sunday terminating President Donald Trump's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization fund" to compensate his political allies.

title: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
description: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.

title: A democratic socialist in the White House? Activists are thinking big.
description: The Democratic Socialists of America summit was abuzz about whether to endorse a presidential candidate, potentially Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.

title: Politics chat: Will Democrats use the war and high prices for their midterm strategy?
description: We look at how the Democratic party is approaching the midterms, and if they are using issues like the war in Iran and affordability, to their advantage.

title: Trump says he's canceling Iran strikes; deal pending
description: Trump said Iran and other Middle Eastern countries had asked the U.S. "to hold off any attack" on Iran because "the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to."

title: Bill championed by late Senator Lindsey Graham seeks to increase sanctions on Russia
description: A bipartisan bill to impose tough new sanctions on Russia is making progress in the U.S. Senate. But concerns over how the bill grants President Trump new tariff authorities is complicating the path.

title: U.S. general warns Pentagon he lacks sufficient forces to protect Israel
description: A shortage of Navy destroyers, used to defend against Iranian ballistic missile attacks, will force the head of U.S. European Command to prioritize the U.S. homeland instead, officials said.

title: Tuesday referendum tests GOP push to restrict citizen-led ballot initiatives
description: In a referendum Tuesday, voters are being asked to raise the bar for ballot initiatives - a measure backed by Republicans after years of seeing voters allow abortion, expand Medicaid and allow gaming. Voters face similar measures in other states.
